(1) **Yes.** The main banner clearly displays the title **"Stile e registro"** and the header indicates it is part of the **C2** level (Unit 1 of 12).

(2) **Partially.** The step navigation is present, but it only shows **8 visible steps** (Motivazione through Lettura). The remaining 4 steps (Scrittura, Cultura, Missione, Autovalutatione) are likely hidden off-screen to the right or below.

(3) **Yes.** There is a significant layout issue: a large **"Installa Italiano Master"** (Install App) pop-up/promo banner is overlapping the main content area, obscuring the start of the lesson content (step 1/12). Additionally, the step navigation bar appears truncated or overflowing, hiding the final 4 steps from immediate view.
